mainEntity.name: Should I use one AI assistant or several for product development?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several assistants can support one product, but coordination should follow a clear sequence with defined handoffs and one owner responsible for approval. Run My AI Business describes combinations such as opportunity research, course development, video production, and launch preparation, coordinated through a chief-of-staff-style assistant. Key factors: shared definitions, source consistency, output formats, deadlines, duplicate work, and error escalation. Practical guidance: begin with one assistant, write the handoff between stages, and add another only when it removes a proven bottleneck rather than creating more supervision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use one assistant when the workflow is still unclear; add specialized assistants only when separate tasks and handoffs are well defined. A coordinated process can support research, course creation, video, and launch work, but each stage needs consistent inputs, outputs, review rules, and one accountable owner.
